title: add-jsonschema-strict-mode-and-better-error-reporting-to-response_format
author: Avery Cole
release_notes: Adds strict JSON Schema validation for response_format, improves error messages and OpenAI-compatibility for schema failures. Backwards-compatible behavior preserved when strict=false.
description: Context: We previously added response_format=json_schema support but observed ambiguous errors and inconsistent behavior with the OpenAI compatibility layer when schemas failed to validate. This PR introduces a strict mode for response_format (response_format.strict = true) that enforces exact JSON Schema validation on model output, improves deterministic error reporting, and unifies OpenAI-compat fallback semantics. Motivation: customers using structured outputs need predictable validation semantics and machine-readable error payloads for retry/fallback logic. Summary of changes: 1) runtime: new validator pipeline stage that runs after generation and before streaming finalization; it supports both AJV-compatible schemas and our internal lightweight checks when strict mode is enabled; 2) API: response_format field extended with "strict" and "validation_mode" options and explicit error codes; 3) compatibility: the OpenAI compatibility layer now maps Redwood validation errors to OpenAI-style structured errors and provides guidance for function/tool calling fallback; 4) SDKs & docs: updates to Python/TS SDKs and docs with examples and migration notes; 5) telemetry: new metrics (response_format.validation.failure_count, validation.mode_strict_count) and SLI adjustments. Checklist: - [x] Add validator pipeline + unit tests - [x] Implement response_format.strict semantics and config parsing - [x] Map errors to OpenAI-compat schema for SDKs - [x] Update SDKs (python/typescript) examples & docs - [x] Add end-to-end tests with streaming + validation - [x] Add telemetry and dashboard widgets Commits (high level): - a1f4b3c Add strict validation stage and validator interface - d9c2e8f Implement response_format.strict parsing and schema merging - b7e6a21 OpenAI-compat: structured validation error mapping and codes - c4a9d3e SDK: python/ts surface updates and examples - e02f14b Add e2e tests and telemetry metrics Changed areas / files (high level): - runtime/validate/validator.go (new): validator pipeline and adapter for AJV-compatible rules - api/response_format.proto: extended schema with strict and validation_mode fields - middleware/openai_compat/mapping.go: maps Redwood errors to OpenAI-compatible error objects - sdk/python/redwood/response_format.py: parses new fields and surfaces structured errors - sdk/ts/src/response-format.ts: compatibility helpers and migration notes - docs/guides/structured-output.md: new section on strict mode and migration examples - tests/e2e/response_format_strict_test.py: end-to-end streaming + validation tests Small illustrative snippet (kept inline to avoid large diffs): "response_format": {"type": "json_schema", "schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}}}}},"required":["id","items"]}, "strict": true} Review conversation (summary as timeline): - Jordan Kim (reviewer): "Great direction. Please separate the AJV adapter from the runtime validator so we can swap implementations later." - Avery Cole (author): "Acknowledged. AJV adapter extracted to runtime/validate/ajv_adapter.go and added interface tests." - Ravi Patel (reviewer): "Can we avoid blocking streaming flushes on validation for non-strict mode? We should surface partial results and a non-fatal validation warning." - Avery Cole: "Implemented non-blocking validation for strict=false. Behavior: streaming completes, telemetry emits validation.warning, and SDKs receive validation_warning field in response metadata." - Samira Ahmed (security reviewer): "Schema loading looked fine, but please ensure remote schema refs are disabled by default to avoid SSRF." - Avery Cole: "Disabled remote refs by default; added a server flag `--allow-remote-schemas` and documented secure defaults." - Jordan Kim: "One last nit on error codes – prefer short machine codes (VALIDATION_SCHEMA_MISMATCH -> VAL_SCHEMA_MISMATCH). Updated mapping in middleware." - Avery Cole: "Done, updated mapping and SDK translations."

notes: This PR primarily touches runtime validation and API surface. The change is backwards compatible when strict=false. Customers who opt-in to strict=true should test streaming behaviors. Telemetry keys added to help monitor adoption and failure modes.
